name: Secret source loading

test_list.description: A deterministic isolated source provider loads a synthetic environment value into the vault.
A missing environment source returns EnvMissing and does not invoke a secret callback.
An injected fixture source loads synthetic keyring data without reading the user's OS credential store.
A credential-store failure is typed and its display/debug output does not contain backend values.
Source values above the configured maximum are rejected before sealing.
The keyring adapter delegates storage and lookup through the SDK registry seam using a synthetic provider.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: A validated environment variable or keyring service/account reference.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Credential/environment provider; tests inject a deterministic fixture implementation.

output_description: The secret sealed into the vault, or a typed source/validation error without echoed secret data.
